acquisition: only after OSF public timestamp, attached model/code archive, metadata roster and eligibility signed; a local timestamp or an unrelated registration cannot authorize it
authorship: user-owned: the user will fill author, affiliation, funding and platform/deposit fields

eligibility.daily_mean: agency daily mean, or verified complete subdaily aggregation with QC; no monthly WQ samples
eligibility.network: connected catchments, conservative joins across shared rivers and donors
eligibility.sampling_stop: metadata roster fixed before observations; no performance-based substitutions

E2.empty_groups: report unavailable, do not count as passes

E5.feasibility: Not implementable in the fixed three-zone cohort; report unavailable, not zero-risk certified retention
E5.report: bounded-group certified retention, certificate status and worst-group risk

failure_text: Unchanged source calibration did not meet the prespecified descriptive criteria. With three zones the ten-labeled-group comparison is unavailable; no sufficient local-label budget has been established. Report the observed failures and all qualification/availability limits.

inference.E1_E2_joint_success: intersection, with E1 confidence bound and point-estimate E2; no claim of simultaneous confidence for every group
inference.handling_unavailable: retain denominator and reason; do not impute success
inference.multiplicity: E1 and E2 must both pass; E3/E4 secondary, Holm adjustment for inferential superiority tests

air.aggregation: 24 finite hourly temperatures per fixed NZST day; no interpolation

measurement.native_clock: NZST fixed UTC+12, confirmed by all candidate TimeRange metadata

qc.aggregation: mean of a full regular native day; no interpolation or synthetic records
qc.cadence: monthly timestamp mode up to 60 minutes, shorter tie, must divide 24 hours

metadata_screening.fallback_trigger: fewer than four calendar-supported July-June years or no qualified continuous river series, determined exclusively from metadata
metadata_screening.grouping: Horizons catchment; Greater Wellington conservatively merged surface-water management zones, with any shared donors/connectivity merged before freezing; zone counts are not automatically independent catchment counts
metadata_screening.horizons_result: 58 collection sites screened; zero potentially eligible sites in the current public archive; no predictive test performed

method.batch_policy_scope: not a primary endpoint; any additional batch method must have its full source calibration and individual cap fixed in the public protocol before values, not selected after target outcomes
method.conditional_conformal_scope: auxiliary conservative and independently randomized binary-LAC prediction sets; coverage/false-admission frequency reported separately from selected risk; no substitution for the E2 group-risk endpoint
method.decision: primary single-value release: source-fixed D2 failure score <= 0.1; any separately reported batch policy must also cap individual scores at 0.3
estimators: distribution regression with group-disjoint interval calibration
local_comparators: general-loss semi-supervised RCPS with WSR, distinct unlabeled calibration groups and untouched test groups
method.primary_release_value: calibrated D2 median; this is the source failure classifier's target
method.scope: classical estimation is a comparator; it does not inherit the classifier trained for D2 errors
method.source_model_selection: source-only global candidate already fitted with seed zero and four disjoint group roles; candidate.json records the choice; no target outcomes used
method.target_history_use: Offline reconstruction: daily regression, climatology and residual models use the target station's other historical years under the fixed recipe; the evaluated whole year is excluded. Later historical years may be used. Annual distribution-regression/P2 weights, failure classifier, interval offsets and decision-hot cutoff remain source-only. This is not a real-time forecast or absence of all target-history fitting.

planning.interpretation: No tested equal-seed source planning mixture reaches 80%; algorithm and group-composition variation is substantial. Source-seed quantiles are not new-climate uncertainty or verified transfer power. This is failure-detection design material until publicly registered with a qualified roster.

population: New Zealand regional-council continuous river temperature, Horizons first, followed by independent councils only if the fixed metadata eligibility fails; no temperature values before public registration

prospective_cohort.qualification: metadata only; strict quality-complete years are checked once after registration

status: metadata-roster-frozen failure-detection draft; user platform fields and public registration still pending
success_text: This small prospective cohort met the prespecified descriptive sample criteria. Three conservative management zones do not establish population-level 95 percent risk control, general climate transfer, or any individual conditional guarantee.
